prompt: Write Larkmere Mutual's document "Flood": the policy wording defining flood, one short paragraph only. 120 to 220 words, in the society's own voice, as plain text with no headings or markdown. Return {"text": "..."}.
response: {"text":"Flood means the sudden or unforeseen escape of water onto the insured property from an external source, including water from rivers, streams, canals, lakes, reservoirs, the sea, surface water, heavy rainfall, run-off from land, tidal action, or overflowing drainage systems where this is caused by exceptional weather or other natural conditions. It does not include damage caused solely by wear and tear, poor maintenance, defective design, gradual seepage, or rising damp. Where flood occurs, we will treat as one event any loss arising from the same weather system or water source over a continuous period, unless there is clear interruption and a separate cause. We may ask for evidence from the Met Office, local authorities, drainage bodies, or other relevant sources to help confirm that a flood has taken place. For the purposes of this policy, flood applies only to water that enters or affects the home from outside; it does not include water released from within the home’s own fixed systems, which is covered separately under escape of water. In any case, cover remains subject to the limits, exclusions and conditions shown elsewhere in this policy."}
